name: omniagents-design-patterns
description: Design pattern catalogue and API contract design, split into four skills: software (strict-typed Python 3.13+ in-service patterns — GoF, functional/ADTs, DDD, architectural, in-process concurrency, code anti-patterns), system (strict-typed Python 3.13+ cross-service patterns — reliability, communication, distributed, data, scaling, cloud, distributed anti-patterns), codebase-design (Ousterhout interface depth — deep vs shallow modules, information hiding, deletion test, design-it-twice), and api-design (REST/gRPC API contracts grounded in Google's API Improvement Proposals — retrieved live and cited, never recalled).
